title: Certain controls sync incorrectly when their font changes in certain ways
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.3 and 4.8.dev2

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev2 - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1235U (12 threads) - 7.48 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I have a FontFile without a base font, as that's meant to be provided by the user, with the regular fonts as fallbacks. However, when the user provides the font (using load_dynamic_font() to change base_font, which is documented as valid usage for user-provided fonts), only some UI widgets sync automatically. On reopening, all fonts were correct.

I found queue_redraw() doesn't do anything, but making the font file emit `changed` helps, so the issue may be something about caching.

I discovered this issue for LineEdit and TextEdit, but haven't checked thoroughly if other controls have it. Either way, there is definitely a bug here.

### Steps to reproduce

Try out the MRP. Or:

1. Create a FontFile with a fallback, but no base font
2. Make a button that adds a base font at runtime
3. Use this font for a theme used by the controls, say by creating a theme that adds this font for LineEdit and merging it with the default theme
4. Observe that pressing the button doesn't change things as intended for LineEdits in the scene
5. Observe that only after editing the LineEdit, its font is synced
6. Observe that if you make the font emit changed, the font may be synced too

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[font-file-was-changed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30690091/font-file-was-changed.zip)
